webshare.description:
WebShare is a local file sharing app. You open it, tap "Start," and it gives you a link. Anyone on your WiFi can type that link into their browser and send files or text straight to your phone. No cloud, no signup, just works.

There's a PIN option if you don't want random roommates jumping in. You can also see who's connected and block people if needed. That's pretty much it—simple, fast, gets the job done.
